integrity: The infinite-lattice inequality is proved analytically by a pointwise quadratic majorant. Exact-rational computation checks algebra and representative lattice points only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula is proved for centered integer-valued laws and lattice-aligned one-sided thresholds.
The affine corollary assumes that the mean belongs to the supporting lattice.
The originality search was targeted rather than historically exhaustive; an equivalent result could exist under older moment-problem terminology.
title: Sharp Cantelli bound for centered integer-valued laws
